# `vl fsck`

Verify repository integrity: object hashes, reachability, key rings, embargo records and the operation log. Exits 1 on corruption

```text
vl fsck [OPTIONS]
```

Options:

| | |
|---|---|
| `-v, --verbose` | Also list redacted (expected) objects and notes one by one |
